Case: normal use - Forge reviews a prototype or configures and tests a client repository. Several removed cases contained distinct checks rather than second runs. The removed agents-review case alone exercises the unsigned prototype's P0-only handling and limited prompt at tests/test_agents_review.py:82. The cuts also lose checks for replacing stale app-baseline copies in tests/test_background_refresh_guidance.py, enabling the npm cache in tests/test_client_package_cache.py, the CI full-run instruction at signoff in tests/test_client_signoff_preconditions.py:41, direct `forge test --pytest` worker allocation in Actions in tests/test_ci_test_worker_count.py:17, and the upgrade's combined-script warning in tests/test_combined_script_quick_test.py:72. The retained cases use different inputs or command paths, so those regressions can pass. Carry these checks into new-repo coverage.
